transcriber_notes: SnowPilot chart (JPG). Height axis 160 to 25 cm at 4.03 px/cm, then broken to 0; boundaries read from bar edges against the axis (+-1 cm) and confirmed by test heights (130, 120, 90) and Layer Notes (90-89). Hardness bars grow leftward from F; ends measured against the class ticks (72 px per class). Only the 90-89 cm layer has grain form/size; Moisture and density columns empty throughout. No temperature profile. ECTN12 kept at its printed/arrowed height (fracture without propagation).
